headline: MCA reportedly notifies Overseas Listing Amendment Rules 2026; LEAP-1 and 75% QIB rule
summary_points: Reported: MCA has issued the Overseas Listing Amendment Rules 2026 on direct listing of Indian companies' equity abroad.
Report headline refers to equity instruments eligible for overseas listing under the amended rules.
A 75% QIB-related requirement is reportedly part of the amendment; the exact scope is not confirmed.
A form or filing called LEAP-1 is reportedly introduced; its details are not available in the source.
Full text, notification number and effective date were not available; verify on the MCA website.
who_is_affected: Unlisted and listed Indian public companies planning direct listing of equity on overseas exchanges, and their advisers.
action_required: Obtain the official MCA notification, confirm the 75% QIB condition, LEAP-1 filing and effective date before advising clients.

MCA has reportedly notified the Overseas Listing Amendment Rules 2026, according to a TaxGuru report.

What the report highlights:
- Changes relating to equity instruments for overseas listing
- A 75% QIB-related requirement
- A new LEAP-1 filing or form

The notification number, date of issue and effective date are not stated in the material we have seen, so the finer details remain unconfirmed.

For companies eyeing direct listing on foreign exchanges, these rules could shape eligibility, investor conditions and compliance steps. CAs, CS and legal advisers should review the final text closely once available.

We will update as more details emerge.

Please verify with the official MCA source before acting.
